description: South Korea statutory severance pay (toejikgeum): 30 days of average wage per year of service, with retirement income tax, from hire date, last working day and last 3 months of pay. Pass monthlyOrdinaryWage to apply the legal rule that the ordinary wage replaces a lower average wage (Labor Standards Act art. 2(2)); without it only the average wage is used. Rounding follows the Ministry of Employment and Labor severance calculator.

annualBonus.description: Bonuses paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

annualLeavePay.description: Annual-leave allowance paid in the last 12 months (KRW)

monthlyOrdinaryWage.description: Monthly ordinary wage (base pay + fixed allowances). If its daily amount (÷209×8) exceeds the daily average wage, severance is computed from it (KRW)

monthlyPay.description: Average monthly pay for the last 3 months (KRW)

name: severance_pay
